podcast.title: TikTok Viral Success (2021)
podcast.body: In 2021, BoyWithUke, a Korean American bedroom pop singer, achieved global success when one of his songs became a massive hit thanks to its virality on TikTok. This exposure subsequently led to him securing a major label record deal. "In 2021, he had a song blow up around the world thanks to TikTok."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 10: (10-1)

podcast.title: Boy with Uke (Charlie Yang) – Korean-American; Anonymous on TikTok for 2 Years Before Revealing Identity
podcast.body: Boy with Uke is the stage name of Charlie Yang, a Korean-American musician who began posting music to TikTok anonymously, performing in a mask. He maintained this for two years before revealing his face and real name on an Instagram post, saying that performing in a mask had given him confidence at first but had become a hindrance. "He said that performing in a mask gave him confidence at first, but that it had become a hindrance."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
